name: light fire
_note: without matches, with 2 stones: sparks, 1 h, catches 2 times in 3; the stones stay; the wood is only used when it catches
log: You strike stones over dry tinder, seeking a lasting spark.
Sparks fall upon the tinder, but most vanish before they can set it alight.
Sparks fly as you strike the stones. Your knuckles ache.

text: A spark holds. You blow, and it becomes a flame.
The dry fibres begin to smoke; an instant later a small flame rises among them.
The tinder catches at last. You feed it twig by twig.
The sparks die in the tinder, one after another. Not this time.
A little smoke appears, then vanishes. The wood is still fit for another trial.
Your hands are numb before a spark holds.
